verdict.rationale: The skills produce AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the workflow. They give a parity score with what is missing from your clone, turn real user reviews into fixes and a positioning angle, and offer an entrepreneur mode that helps judge whether to clone at all. However, the insights draw on the target app's public data and the clone project, not on a general analysis of the user's own data. missing for 10: insights over arbitrary user-owned data, documentation of how suggestions are generated and surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Compares your clone against the original. A parity score and what is missing.
Reads what the app's users hate in real reviews and turns it into fixes and a positioning angle.
/replica-entrepreneur on an app you are only thinking about cloning is a good way to find out if you should.
